scope: Nine bounded example leads; no claim of exhaustive exemplar coverage. Only inspected source assertions are retained.

candidates.inspected: Depositor metadata, polymer/UniProt cross-reference and primary-publication abstract on RCSB.
candidates.supported_assertion: The experimentally determined lambda repressor-operator complex contains the HTH region described by the primary study.
candidates.representation_selection: A whole-structure representative anchor for the source-described HTH region is defensible with explicit protein chains and no invented bounds.
qualification_gaps: Exact HTH residue selection not inspected.
No pinned UniProt sequence/fetch receipt or complete SIFTS mapping.
Generic internal-ID source contract/producer unavailable.

candidates.supported_assertion: The entry represents experimentally determined chicken triosephosphate isomerase. Exact BAB motif selection was not established in inspected primary text.
candidates.representation_selection: Candidate only: do not infer a local motif occurrence from the full TIM-barrel fold name.
qualification_gaps: No primary source-selected BAB residue set.
No pinned UniProt reference or residue-level mapping.
Generic internal-ID source contract/producer unavailable.

candidates.inspected: Depositor metadata, polymer/UniProt cross-reference and primary-publication abstract on RCSB.
candidates.supported_assertion: The entry is wild-type human gammaD-crystallin; the associated publication compares wild-type and R58H structures. The inspected abstract does not identify a specific Greek-key motif or its residues.
candidates.representation_selection: Candidate only until a primary/source-native annotation identifies the local Greek-key motif. Do not treat the two-domain protein as one four-strand motif.
qualification_gaps: Specific Greek-key motif selection/bounds not inspected.
No pinned UniProt reference or residue-level mapping.
Generic internal-ID source contract/producer unavailable.

candidates.inspected: 2GB1 depositor metadata/primary NMR abstract; direct PubMed abstract for experimental B1 fragment characterization.
candidates.supported_assertion: The NMR study establishes the 56-residue B1-domain topology. The separate fragment experiment explicitly identifies B1 residues 1-20 and 41-56 as beta-hairpin fragments, with conditions affecting their populations.
candidates.representation_selection: Plausible source-grounded representative after exact construct/frame correspondence is checked. Do not copy fragment numbering into full-protein UniProt coordinates.

asserted_residue_coordinates.source_frame: Protein G B1 domain fragment numbering in PMID7607238; not asserted as UniProt coordinates or a verified 2GB1 mapping

qualification_gaps: Exact publication-construct to PDB and full-length UniProt correspondence unverified.
No pinned full-length UniProt reference or residue-level mapping.
Generic internal-ID source contract/producer unavailable.

candidates.inspected: Depositor metadata, polymer cross-reference and primary-publication abstract.
candidates.supported_assertion: The primary study reports local differences in the B1-domain loop spanning residues 46-51. That six-residue loop statement does not identify a specific four-residue beta turn.
candidates.representation_selection: Do not install a beta-turn exemplar from this evidence alone. Requires source-assigned turn type/residues.
qualification_gaps: Exact beta-turn assignment absent from inspected source text.
No residue mapping or native generic producer.

candidates.inspected: Depositor metadata, polymer/UniProt cross-references and primary-publication abstract.
candidates.supported_assertion: The study directly determines Bcl-xL bound to a Bak peptide and tests interaction-disrupting mutations. It supports an experimental protein-binding interface. The inspected abstract does not itself establish a geometric groove boundary.
candidates.representation_selection: Protein-binding-site representative anchor is supported; GROOVE remains a candidate requiring source-specific geometry.
qualification_gaps: Contact residue sets and full-length frame mappings not inspected.
PDB metadata lists E. coli for the Bcl-xL entity but its UniProt cross-reference is human; organism must ultimately come from same-release UniProt, not expression metadata.
No pinned UniProt references/receipts or supported generic SIFTS contract.

candidates.inspected: Depositor metadata, zinc ligand identity, polymer/UniProt cross-reference and primary-publication abstract.
candidates.supported_assertion: The study describes the carbonic-anhydrase zinc environment, active-site substrate interactions and proton transfer involving His64. This supports a representative metal site; full coordinating/catalytic residue sets were not inspected.
candidates.representation_selection: Metal-site structural anchor is supported. The paper calls the active-site environment a cavity, but it must not be equated to the current enclosed/solvent-inaccessible CAVITY class. POCKET and catalytic-residue assignments need their own selected regions.

asserted_residue_coordinates.source_frame: Numbering used in primary publication abstract; not mapped to UniProt

qualification_gaps: Complete source residue sets and residue-by-residue SIFTS replay absent.
Existing UniProt reference is necessary but insufficient.
Generic or MetalPDB/M-CSA provider qualification gates remain closed.

candidates.inspected: Depositor metadata, polymer/UniProt cross-reference and primary-publication abstract.
candidates.supported_assertion: The paper tests a series of Leu99/Phe153 substitutions and relates cavity size to structural relaxation and stability. Exact 1L90 construct identity was not resolved here.
candidates.representation_selection: Defer: RCSB metadata labels no mutations despite the linked mutational study. Do not copy a mutant cavity onto the wild-type UniProt accession. Raw source sequence/construct verification is required.
qualification_gaps: Exact engineered variant and cavity-lining residues unresolved.
No pinned reference or mapping.
Native qualification cannot accept an unexamined mutant-to-wild-type correspondence.

candidates.inspected: Depositor metadata, inhibitor ligand and modified-residue metadata, polymer/UniProt cross-reference and primary-publication abstract.
candidates.supported_assertion: The source reports experimentally observed binding of a cyclic-urea inhibitor to dimeric HIV protease, replacing a structural water interaction. A full pocket boundary is not asserted by the inspected abstract.
candidates.representation_selection: Candidate only. The dimer-spanning site and mature-protease/polyprotein correspondence require explicit handling; one chain must not represent a multi-chain pocket by assumption.
qualification_gaps: Exact pocket-lining residues and both participants uninspected.
P04585 is the source-associated polyprotein; mature-chain mapping remains unverified.
Modified CSO residues are listed and need source-frame handling.
No pinned UniProt/SIFTS receipts or generic producer.

licensing.inspected_locator: Usage Policy, archive data files under CC0 1.0 Universal; attribution encouraged.
licensing.limits: This policy applies to PDB archive data, not an automatic license for journal text, all web-page content, UniProt data or SIFTS outputs. No journal prose is copied into this dossier.

native_boundary: Representation anchors can preserve source-backed experimental structural evidence; they are not QUALIFIED UniProt examples. Every candidate here remains unpromoted.
access_failures: Some PubMed/PMC/publisher full-text requests returned empty pages, browser challenges or errors; uninspected content was not used.
